why: TWO SURFACES SERVE THIS MCP AND THEY ARE MAINTAINED BY HAND, SEPARATELY. src/mcp.ts is the stdio catalogue (`npx @uuidna/uuidna`); src/mcp-http.ts is the Cloudflare Workers edge behind https://uuidna.com/mcp, which serves the Workers-safe subset — no filesystem, no process, no child_process. Nothing computed one from the other, so they drift: the edge advertised version 0.1.1 through eleven releases while the package reached 0.2.5, and src/tests/mcp-version.test.ts was written to hold that one constant. This file holds the OTHER drift the version test cannot see — tools whose ARGUMENT CONTRACT differs between the two surfaces, and tools the edge serves under a name the stdio catalogue does not use. An agent that learns a tool against uuidna.com and then runs it over stdio gets a wrong answer or an error, and until now nothing said so. Recorded 2026-08-20; THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. A new divergence fails src/tests/mcp-surface.test.ts by name; a divergence that has been repaired must be deleted from here, because a stale entry is an excuse nobody is spending. Repairing one means changing a published contract on one of the two surfaces, so each is a deliberate decision, not a typo to sweep.

argumentDivergence.note: the same mint under two argument names — the most-called tool on both surfaces
the honesty gate; the edge also runs a different function (reveal) than the stdio tool (computes)
the stdio tool runs the whole trial with no arguments; the edge adjudicates one statement
the edge defaults every term, so a bare call bills against zeros instead of refusing
